title: Looking for more feedback on a Roguelite Autobattler!
author: TheRisingRonin
selftext:
Thank you all for the candid feedback on my previous post. I've spent the last week re-working basically every UI surface in the game. I also went back to my previous title, Warlord's Road. I think there's still a handful of small things to do, but I think I need a little more community steering before making some decisions. Overall I think it's in a much better state and again thank you for your thoughts.

AI specifically, I ended up having gemini, claude, and codex all fight over basically coming up with a design system. Which things are a decision to made, what's wayfinding, and just info. Once we had a bit of a UI map, then we started iterating on design. I ended up leaning hard into this storyteller and book design. Still went through every single UI and interaction to make sure it followed some of the higher level ideas. But overall, I think its pretty good (but we all know what my opinion is worth).

You can play it here: [https://therisingronin.itch.io/warlords-road](https://therisingronin.itch.io/warlords-road)  
There's also builds for MacOS and Android.
